11th Grade U.S. History

Great Depression: Photo Detective + Survival Challenge

Two activities in one • 35–45 minutes • No math • Short responses

First, investigate six authentic historical photographs. Then imagine you're living through the Great Depression and make five survival decisions. There are no perfect choices—explain your thinking.

All six historical photographs are embedded in this file and do not require an internet connection. Your written answers stay in this browser unless you copy or download them.

Historical photographs supplied by your teacher and embedded in this activity. Source credits are provided where known. For educational classroom use.
